title: Donald Trump takes office as US President (first term)
label: Trump takes office
description: Donald Trump, elected in November 2016, takes office as President of the United States; his first term runs to January 2021 and brings the 2018 steel and aluminium tariffs.

title: EU-Canada trade agreement (CETA) provisionally applied
label: CETA applied
description: Most of the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement between the EU and Canada applies provisionally, removing tariffs on most goods.

title: US Section 232 tariffs on EU steel and aluminium
label: US steel tariffs
description: The United States applies tariffs of 25% on steel and 10% on aluminium imported from the EU, until the tariff-rate quota deal of January 2022.

title: EU rebalancing duties on US products
label: EU rebalancing duties
description: In response to the US steel and aluminium tariffs, the EU applies additional duties on a list of US products (Implementing Regulation (EU) 2018/886).

title: EU safeguard measures on steel imports
label: EU steel safeguard
description: Provisional, then definitive, safeguard quotas on imports of steel products into the EU, to stop steel diverted from the US market.

title: EU-Japan Economic Partnership Agreement enters into force
label: EU-Japan agreement
description: The EU-Japan Economic Partnership Agreement removes most tariffs on trade between the EU and Japan.

title: The United Kingdom leaves the EU; transition period
label: Brexit
description: The UK leaves the EU under the Withdrawal Agreement. EU rules on trade keep applying until the end of the transition period on 31 December 2020.

title: WHO declares COVID-19 a pandemic
label: COVID-19
description: The World Health Organization characterises COVID-19 as a pandemic. Lockdowns across Europe follow within days, and trade falls sharply in the second quarter of 2020.

title: Luxembourg COVID-19 lockdown and state of crisis
label: Luxembourg lockdown
description: Luxembourg closes non-essential shops and activities and declares a state of crisis, lifted on 24 June 2020.

title: EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement applies
label: EU-UK trade agreement
description: After the transition period, trade with the UK runs under the Trade and Cooperation Agreement: no tariffs or quotas, but customs formalities and rules of origin.

title: The Ever Given blocks the Suez Canal
label: Suez Canal blocked
description: A container ship runs aground in the Suez Canal and blocks it for six days, delaying shipping between Asia and Europe.

title: US-EU tariff-rate quotas on steel and aluminium
label: US-EU steel truce
description: The US replaces the Section 232 tariffs on EU steel and aluminium with tariff-rate quotas, and the EU suspends its rebalancing duties.

title: Russia invades Ukraine; first EU sanctions packages
label: Sanctions on Russia
description: Russia invades Ukraine. The EU adopts sanctions packages restricting trade with Russia, and energy and commodity prices jump.

title: European gas price peak
label: Gas price peak
description: The European wholesale gas price reaches its highest level, raising the value of energy imports and the costs of energy-intensive industry.

title: Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism: transitional period starts
label: CBAM reporting
description: Importers of iron and steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers and some chemicals start reporting the embedded emissions of their goods.

title: Red Sea shipping disruption
label: Red Sea disruption
description: Attacks on ships in the Red Sea divert container traffic between Asia and Europe around the Cape of Good Hope, lengthening voyages and raising freight rates.

title: EU countervailing duties on battery electric vehicles from China
label: EU duties on Chinese EVs
description: The EU imposes definitive countervailing duties on imports of new battery electric vehicles from China.

title: Donald Trump takes office as US President (second term)
label: Trump's second term
description: Donald Trump, elected on 5 November 2024, takes office as President of the United States for a second term.

title: US Section 232 tariffs of 25% on EU steel and aluminium
label: US steel tariffs 2025
description: The United States ends the tariff-rate quotas and applies 25% tariffs on steel and aluminium from all countries, the EU included.

title: US 'reciprocal' tariffs: a 10% duty on goods from all partners, the EU included
label: US 10% tariffs
description: Executive Order 14257, signed on 2 April 2025, adds a 10% duty on imports into the United States from all trading partners from 5 April 2025; higher country rates were announced on top.

title: US Section 232 tariffs on steel and aluminium raised to 50%
label: US steel tariffs 50%
description: A proclamation of 3 June 2025 doubles the US tariffs on steel and aluminium and their derivatives, the EU's included, from 25% to 50% from 4 June 2025.

title: EU-US framework agreement: a 15% US tariff for most EU goods
label: EU-US 15% deal
description: The EU and the United States agree that most EU goods face the higher of the US most-favoured-nation tariff or 15%.
